explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/706: L(r) bounds χ(G) for graphs on finite point sets P ⊂ ℝ² where two points are adjacent iff their distance lies in a set A ⊂ (0,∞) of size r; 'is it true that L(r) ≤ r^{O(1)}?'. The Lean statement: ∃ C : ℕ, for all sufficiently large r, for every finite P ⊂ ℝ² and every finset A of r positive reals, the chromatic number of DistancePlaneGraph A P (adjacent iff distinct and distance ∈ A) is ≤ r^C. Restricting to large r is necessary (L(1) ≥ 5 > 1^C) and is the standard reading of r^{O(1)}, documented in the docstring; an integer exponent loses nothing. The open-ended 'Estimate L(r)' part is not formalised. Faithful.
